objective: Official robustness evaluation of Linear SVM, Character-level CNN, and IndoBERT against four text obfuscation families (O1, O2, O3, O4) at MILD and STRONG severity levels.
research_context: Evaluasi Ketahanan Model Deteksi Promosi Judi Online terhadap Penyamaran Teks pada Komentar YouTube

svm.name: Linear SVM (TF-IDF word unigram + bigram, C=10)

char_cnn.name: Character-level CNN (Multi-scale kernels 3,5,7, Candidate B, lr=1e-3, drop=0.5)

indobert.name: IndoBERT Base p2 Fine-Tuned (Candidate C, lr=3e-5, wd=0)

methodological_rules: No threshold adjustment: default decision boundaries from Stage 9 are locked.
Paired robustness metrics use only successfully transformed records (changed == True).
F1 Drop is defined as F1_normal_paired - F1_obfuscated_paired.
Evasion flip rate denominator is normal true-positive count in the paired subset.
95% bootstrap CI uses 10,000 stratified paired resamples with fixed seed 42.
